chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Abi Qatada, from a man, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The people do not enjoy in the world and the Hereafter a pleasure greater for them than the pleasure of women.'
'It has been adorned for people, the love of desires, from women and sons' – up to the end of the verse.
Then he said: 'And the people of Paradise do not enjoy anything in Paradise more desirable to them than marriage, neither food nor drink.'
ai.seo_question: What is the greatest pleasure for humans in Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies conjugal pleasure as the supreme delight for humanity, grounding this in the Quranic verse (3:14) that describes the adornment of love for women and children as a test of worldly life. He further distinguishes the eternal nature of this pleasure in Paradise, asserting that marital intimacy holds greater satisfaction than sustenance, thereby validating the physical dimension of spiritual bliss in Shia eschatology.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Al Hassan Bin Abu Qatada, from a man, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The people cannot enjoy pleasure in the world and the Hereafter with anything more pleasurable for them than the pleasure of the women, and these are the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [3:14] It has been adorned for the people, the love of desires, from the women and the sons – up to the end of the Verse’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the people of the Paradise would not be enjoying with anything more desirous with them than the ‘النِّكَاحِ’ (marriage), neither the food nor the drink’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah al-Barqiy from al-Hassan ibn abu Qatadah from a man from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The most enjoyable thing people experience in this world and in the hereafter is enjoyment with women
and it is in the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘The love and enjoyment for women and children is made attractive for people.’ [3:13]
He (the Imam) then said, ‘People of paradise will not enjoy from anything else as much as they will with marriage, but not from food or drink.’”
